event_summary: A brown elongated object is released into a tall glass containing blue liquid, producing visible splashes and waves before resting near the bottom.
raw_event_description: At the start, a tall transparent glass stands on a tabletop with blue liquid in its lower portion and a green horizontal band around the glass. A brown elongated object is held just above the glass opening by a blue holder. After a pause, the brown object moves downward through the glass opening into the blue liquid. The liquid surface rises and forms splashes and waves. The brown object becomes visible underwater near the lower part of the glass, angled toward one side. The surface motion gradually diminishes while the object remains near the bottom.

reasons: The glass, blue liquid, green band, brown object, and blue holder are visible.
The brown object is positioned above the liquid before the main downward motion.
